notes.title: This game is being removed from the store!
notes.notes:
This game will be removed from the store!

I wanted to take this decision a long time ago...

Let me explain you what happened...

I was learning a new engine and pfff since I was a beginner I screwed up everything...

I feel like its too bad to leave a game on steam that doesnt work well...

I also feel like this game could be deteriorating my image as a game-dev.

I also feel like having a paid dlc for a malfunctioning game isnt a good Idea...

I really hope you understand my decision!

I am always evolving and doing things better with time!

I pray my next game will be somewhat satisfactory for you guys!

Peace***

notes.title: Well.... I am impressed...
notes.notes:
Guys I am making a new game... Its still in the begining....

I might make it entirely free without DLCS as an apology for you guys...

I am being able to draw even better with time...

I am also becoming a better coder....

Btw GMS2 is a good engine lots of people makes great games with it its one of the most popular 2D game engines out there.....

But yes that wrong version patch ruined everything....

I am trying different things this time around....

I am still deciding wich engine I will use I am in between GMS2 or C3....

I think there is a 80% chance of my next game being made on C3 tough...
bc I just love the work enviroment =P

I honestly thought when game launched that everyone was being mean for free against me....
xD

But no ! The game indeed is broken and I am really  sorry for it...

I had big hopes for this game its my first kind of Top Down adventure and it was a real challenge 
learning a new engine and a new game concept....

I am certain the lessons learned with KNC will be proven usefull....

I am also very happy that I am getting a lot of support from you guys...

this game was a hughe defeat for me!!

But lets look into the future!!

I will try to make a neat game for you all!

=) thanks!

One thing is certain and I guarantee you this.... Next time I will make 2 backups maybe even 3....
So no more Save Wipes...

thanks!

notes.title: I am sorry!
notes.notes:
Guys I believe my last patch broke the game bc I patched with a wrong version...

Thats why everyone is getting massive errors...

To make things worse I dont think the game is saving...(The code is probably commented)

I also formated my computer ...(I did backup this project)

but the project backed up somehow.... is an old project....

I dont know what went wrong ... I really dont...

It appears it wasnt my fault as well ( apprently when the engine updates ... some projects get broken)

Anyways thats something new I had to learn....

I hope it doesnt happen in the future!

notes.title: Sword DMG fixed! Armor Fixed!
notes.notes:
I think there was a bug in sword dmg not loading variables.
The same is for armor...

Anyways now both armor and sword should be functioning properly!

notes.title: Tower Bug (Tips)
notes.notes:
The game was still bugging when going into tutorial and back at tower...

Its is now fixed!

notes.title: Good News!
notes.notes:
I regretted my decision of removing my game...
I was totally driven by an emotional outburst when I 
saw all of the Bug Reports...

I have managed to fix the reported bugs and made a patch!

If there are still bugs in the game please report them!

Sorry for the random Bans and Ignores as of recently....
I was very mad that I screwed it up
and I threw my anger on you..

Allow me a second chance 

I am trying to change and improve as a Game Dev
and as a Person...

Thank you very much for this!

notes.title: Sorry!
notes.notes:
I am sorry for the recent rage of my part on DISCORD...

Sometimes we loose ourselves...

I need some time tough before I make another game...

I decided to not quit... 

I love game dev and wish to keep making games ...

I just need to think this trough and try out new things...

New genres New models...

New types of games...

I need to be inspired again..

I AM still removing KNC.... There are too many problems...

There is a lot I need to think trough 

thanks!
